title: A live blog of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, where new iPhone 18 Pro, Apple's first foldable phone, new Apple Watches, and AirPods are expected (The Verge)
summary: The Verge: A live blog of Apple's “Surprise and Shine” event, where new iPhone 18 Pro, Apple's first foldable phone, new Apple Watches, and AirPods are expected — It's not just time for any old Apple event, but one that's expected to usher in a new era for the company.
